causal_hypotheses.quality_policy: For this simple deterministic semantic suite, disabling GLM thinking at the chat-template boundary prevents cap-driven truncation and passes the frozen quality screen without changing the fixed performance workload or output cap.
causal_hypotheses.mtp: Changing only to official GLM MTP/EAGLE improves matched fixed-8K/1K c8 SLO-goodput by at least 5% while both arms pass SLO, exact normalized reasoning-off quality identity, and paired quality gates.

falsification_rules.quality_policy: Reject if any response reaches the unchanged 256-token cap, deterministic repetitions diverge, the quality self-score fails, or evidence is incomplete.
falsification_rules.mtp: Reject if c8 improvement is below 5%, either arm fails fixed SLO, exact normalized quality identity fails, paired quality fails, or artifact/cleanup fails.
falsification_rules.economics: Do not claim provider competitiveness without matched provider workload, quality, and service-level evidence. Report fixed-workload compute-only estimates separately.

predictions.quality_policy: The first quality response will stop before 256 tokens and the development self-score will pass.
predictions.fixed_c8_output_tokens_per_second: 280 to 330; outside this range triggers drift review
predictions.mtp: If the runtime accepts the integrated MTP configuration, improvement is uncertain and the >=5% gate is deliberately falsifiable.
predictions.business_threshold: Even a 5% MTP pass is insufficient to close the measured roughly 3.1x gap to the historical $0.88/M analytical anchor.
